verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Zoho CRM's own MCP server, which external AI tools such as Cursor and Claude Desktop connect to. That is the server role and does not show Zoho CRM or Zia consuming third-party MCP servers. Nothing in the pack shows Zia Agent Studio or any other part of the product registering external MCP servers to use their tools, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
